en: The postcard shows an old photograph depicting a palace-like building on a coastal cliff. The structure is prominent and appears luxurious, with a flag flying on top of a tower. The foreground features a large body of water, suggesting the palace is near the sea. The bottom of the front side presents text in Bulgarian and French, identifying the building as the Palace of Euxinograd in Varna. The reverse side of the postcard contains handwritten text in Cyrillic script, Bulgarian postage stamps, and publication information, all confirming its Bulgarian origin.
